text:
maria: Heads-up, external assessment confirmed for 2/3 next week (Tue-Fri). Need final decisions on: assessor RBAC, KMS access pattern for evidence, audit log scrubbing, and a retest window. Who can own the remediation tracker?

aj: I can start the tracker in Notion. Can we lock the retest to a week after release freeze? we can't overlap with the 2.5.0 cut.

maria: Yes, prefer retest window 2 business days after freeze ends. Add a hard no-overlap constraint with release tags.

samir: For RBAC: recommend ephemeral assessor roles scoped to only a handful of read-only policies (S3:GetObject, CloudTrail:LookupEvents). No console write. We'll auto-revoke after window.

kate: +1. Also we need to scrub PII from logs before handing over any CloudTrail/ELB logs. Suggest a two-phase evidence flow: staging bucket (restricted) -> scrub job -> presigned URL.

maria: Sounds good. Who owns scrub job? we have a small regex sanitizer in infra but it misses token-like strings.

aj: I can wire up a Lambda scrub job. Quick checklist: (1) KMS-decrypt only in scrub step, (2) scrub ruleset from legal/privacy, (3) signed evidence packaging.

samir: KMS note: do NOT give assessors raw KMS decrypt. Instead create a KMS-proxy lambda that decrypts in-memory and writes scrubbed plaintext to the staging bucket (encrypted with a distinct key). Assessor sees only the staging bucket objects.

ops-oncall: We'll need to map SSM session-manager or ephemeral SSH to the assessor personas for any live triage. Suggest using short STS tokens (1h) generated by ops with dedicated IAM role.

maria: Good. Also need audit logging coverage: CloudTrail + sentinel logs + application request IDs. Retention for handed evidence should be 90 days minimum for the engagement.

kate: Legal wants an audit proof that shows who accessed what, at row level if possible. We'll attach a CSV access manifest for each object.

aj: I'll include a Notion template with columns: vuln-id, severity, owner, remediation ETA, evidence links, assessor notes, retest slot. Assigning initial owners now.

samir: Quick policy snippet for ephemeral role (pseudo):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-staging/*"]},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":["*"]}
  ]
}
```

kate: That looks good; deny kms:Decrypt is important. Proxy lambda will need a separate key policy.

maria: Who can run the dry-run scrub tomorrow morning? want to exercise pipeline + manifest generation.

aj: I can run it between 09:30-10:30 PT. tagging @ops-oncall for STS token issuance.

ops-oncall: Got it. I'll create the temp roles and post creds in 1Password cockpit. Will add timeboxed expiration and an approval step.

security-bot: Reminder: open-source assessor tool (redcoat) requires outbound HTTPS; whitelist redcoat IPs in egress policy or use a NAT with logging.

maria: Noted. aj, please list egress needs in the tracker. Also add rollback plan if scrub fails (revoke assessor access immediately).

aj: Tracker created: https://notion.so/rw/pt-remediation-1795550001 (will fill details after dry-run).

samir: After the retest, we should run an automated regression eval on top-10 prompts + infra-change smoke tests.

kate: I'll own the manifest/audit cert generation step.

maria: Thanks team — action items: aj -> tracker + dry-run, samir -> lambda proxy + role docs, ops-oncall -> temp creds, kate -> manifest template, legal -> scrub rules (cc @kate). We'll sync tomorrow 09:15 PT in #eng-security. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Acknowledged.

security-bot: Deploy pipeline note: ensure scrub lambda has VPC access to staging bucket if required.

maria: closing loop — if anything blocks the dry-run ping here.
